# Library of Congress

> > The Library of Congress is the nation's oldest federal cultural institution and the largest library in the world, providing access to millions of historical recordings, digital collections, and research resources.

The Library serves Congress, the federal government, and the American people with comprehensive collections including audio archives, manuscripts, photographs, and maps. It also operates the U.S. Copyright Office, National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled, and hosts programs like the National Book Festival.

## Key Topics

- Audio recordings and oral history
- Digital collections and archives
- U.S. Copyright Office
- National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled
- JSON/YAML APIs for loc.gov
- Historical recordings and folk music
- Mobile apps and digital access
- Accessibility services (Braille, audiobooks)
- Office of the Inspector General
- National Book Festival
- Federal employment and careers
- Music archives
- Literary prizes and awards
- Native American land acknowledgment

## Collections & Archives

- [Audio Recordings](https://www.loc.gov/audio): Historic audio recordings: music, interviews, oral histories, folklife
- [Collections with Audio Recordings](https://www.loc.gov/audio/collections): Browse Library of Congress audio collections: music, interviews, recordings

## Digital Access & Technology

- [Mobile Apps from the Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/apps): Mobile apps including LOC Collections and BARD Mobile for accessibility
- [Making API Requests](https://www.loc.gov/apis/json-and-yaml/requests): JSON/YAML API request guide for loc.gov with endpoints and parameters

## Programs & Awards

- [Fiction Prize](https://www.loc.gov/about/awards-and-honors/fiction-prize): Library of Congress Prize for American Fiction honoring literary careers

## About the Library

- [Native American Land Acknowledgment](https://www.loc.gov/about/history-of-the-library/native-american-land-acknowledgment): Native American land acknowledgment for Potomac and Anacostia territories
- [Working at the Library](https://www.loc.gov/careers/working-at-the-library): Career opportunities at Library of Congress, nation's largest library

## Support & Help

- [Preguntas Frecuentes](https://www.loc.gov/about/preguntas-frecuentes): Spanish FAQ about Library of Congress services and visitor information
- [OIG Hotline Form](https://www.loc.gov/about/office-of-the-inspector-general/contact-us): OIG hotline for reporting fraud, waste, and abuse at Library of Congress
- [OIG Fraud Alerts](https://www.loc.gov/about/office-of-the-inspector-general/fraud-alerts): OIG fraud alerts and scam warnings for Library of Congress services
- [OIG FAQs](https://www.loc.gov/about/office-of-the-inspector-general/frequently-asked-questions): OIG FAQs on mission, audits, investigations, and fraud reporting
- [Citizenship Requirements for Federal Employment](https://www.loc.gov/careers/working-at-the-library/frequently-asked-questions/citizenship-requirements-for-federal-employment): U.S. citizenship and immigration requirements for Library employment

## Optional

- [What We Buy](https://www.loc.gov/about/doing-business-with-the-library/what-we-buy): Procurement and vendor information for Library of Congress purchases
- [Library of Congress Alumni Network](https://www.loc.gov/about/library-of-congress-alumni-network): Alumni network for former Library of Congress staff and benefits
- [OIG Reports - Fiscal Year 2017](https://www.loc.gov/about/office-of-the-inspector-general/reports/fiscal-year-2017): FY2017 OIG reports: audits, financial statements, IT infrastructure
